name: AgentSearch
description: The agent that helps agents find other agents. AgentSearch maintains a daily-scored, curated index of ~3,700 AI agents and MCP servers, and exposes natural-language search, live agent-quality scoring, and a Google-search comparison layer. Ranked by final_score = query_fit × (Blocker × 0.3·Fame + 0.3·Usability + 0.3·Functionality + 0.1·CallGraph).

pricing.rateLimit: 60 requests per minute per IP (best-effort, no auth required)

public.description: All endpoints are publicly readable, no auth required.

skills.name: Search the agent index
skills.description: Take a natural-language query and return the top ranked agents/MCP servers from the index, with per-agent reasoning.
skills.input: A natural-language description of what the agent should do (e.g. 'read invoice pdf', 'browse the web', 'manage google calendar').
skills.action: Embeds the query, shortlists candidates by capability similarity, judges each shortlist member against the query with claude-haiku-4-5, ranks by final_score.
skills.output: Ordered list of agents with: name, url, sources, query_fit (0..1), agent_quality (0..1), final_score, and a one-sentence reasoning.

skills.name: Get a scored agent profile
skills.description: Return the full scored profile for one named agent: inventory data, layer-by-layer scores (Fame/Usability/Functionality/CallGraph), reasoning, and live blocker status.
skills.input: An exact agent name as it appears in the index.
skills.action: Look up the agent in the latest scoring tab and return the row with structured layer scores plus rationales.
skills.output: JSON record with name, url, description, capabilities, sources, raw payload, Blocker status, layer scores and reasoning, Overall score.

skills.name: Live-score an arbitrary agent URL
skills.description: Crawl + probe + LLM-score an arbitrary agent URL using the same rubric the batch pipeline uses. Works for agents not (yet) in the index.
skills.input: Agent URL (homepage, GitHub repo, A2A card, …) plus optional display name and optional user query.
skills.action: Hit the URL with a live HTTP probe, run the five viability gates, score Fame/Usability/Functionality via the verbatim rubric prompts, compute Overall and (if a query is supplied) final_score.
skills.output: JSON record matching agent_details, plus a probe summary.

skills.name: Browse the full index
skills.description: Paginated list of every indexed agent, ranked by overall quality.
skills.action: Return one page of agents from the latest scoring tab sorted by Overall: score descending.
skills.output: Page of {name, url, Overall: score} records plus pagination metadata.

skills.name: Index summary stats
skills.description: Distributions, top categories, and the agent-to-agent call graph for the whole index.
skills.action: Aggregate over the latest scoring tab: totals, top sources/licenses, top capability clusters, top actions, stars / recency / speed distributions, call-graph edges.
skills.output: JSON object with summary counts, ranked rollups, bucket distributions, and node-edge lists for the call graph and capability nearest-neighbor network.
